theme.title: Miami's Finals years
theme.subtitle: Heat, 2012 and 2013
theme.recap: Miami beat Oklahoma City and then survived San Antonio, thanks in part to a corner three with seconds left.

questions.prompt: How many points did LeBron James score in Game 7 of the 2013 Finals?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)

funFacts.text: A short Tim Duncan miss and a missed tip helped Miami survive San Antonio's late rally in the decider.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)

funFacts.text: LeBron's jumper late in Game 7 finally secured Miami's repeat championship.

source.quote: James went on to hit a 17-foot jumper that secured the victory

funFacts.text: Shane Battier's outside shooting helped cover scoreless games from both Chris Bosh and Ray Allen.
